# Amber Randhawa, Realtor

> Amber Randhawa is a Realtor with Keller Williams Realty Cityside (Georgia license #453822, NAR member) serving metro Atlanta and northwest Georgia: Paulding, Haralson, Carroll, Polk and Cobb counties. She was born and raised on a dirt road near Draketown and works homes, land and family property in Dallas, Hiram, Bremen, Buchanan, Tallapoosa, Rockmart, Cedartown, Villa Rica and Carrollton. Mobile 770-634-3291. Office: Keller Williams Realty Cityside, 3350 Atlanta Rd SE, Smyrna, GA 30080, 770-874-6200.

The guides publish measured local numbers (drive times, millage rates, school eligibility) with the method behind them. Listings are on her Keller Williams site, not this one.

## About and contact

- [About Amber Randhawa](https://amberrandhawa.com/about/): Background, 25 years in investigations and technical writing before real estate, license and brokerage details

## Guides

- [All guides](https://amberrandhawa.com/guides/): Buyer guides for northwest Georgia
- [Commuting to Atlanta](https://amberrandhawa.com/commuting-to-atlanta/): Measured drive times from six towns to downtown Atlanta, the airport and Cobb County
- [Georgia property taxes](https://amberrandhawa.com/property-taxes/): Millage rates, HB 581, and how to estimate a real bill
- [Bremen City vs Haralson County schools](https://amberrandhawa.com/bremen-city-schools-vs-haralson-county-schools/): Eligibility, tuition and how to check an address
- [Villa Rica taxes: Carroll vs Douglas County](https://amberrandhawa.com/villa-rica-property-taxes-carroll-county-vs-douglas-county/): Which side a home is on and what it costs
- [Moving to Rockmart](https://amberrandhawa.com/moving-to-rockmart-ga/): Living in Rockmart, schools, utilities, the Atlanta drive
- [Buying land in northwest Georgia](https://amberrandhawa.com/buying-land-northwest-georgia/): Zoning, septic, wells, CUVA, easements and land loans by county
- [Living near the Silver Comet Trail](https://amberrandhawa.com/living-near-silver-comet-trail/): Trailheads by town and what backing up to the trail is like
